content_units: A clean schedule is possible within 09:30-17:30, keeps at least 15 minutes between meetings for every participant, and places lunch before the latest allowed start.
09:30-10:15   Kickoff   45 min   PM, Engineer 1, Engineer 2, Designer, Sales Lead
10:30-11:30   Design Review   60 min   PM, Designer, Engineer 1
11:45-12:30   Engineering Sync   45 min   PM, Engineer 1, Engineer 2
13:15-13:45   Pricing Discussion   30 min   PM, Sales Lead
-   Work hours 09:00-17:30:   all sessions fit inside the window
-   15-minute gap between meetings per person:   satisfied for all attendees
-   Lunch break 30 minutes, starting no later than 13:30:   lunch starts at   12:30
-   Required attendee combinations:   all covered exactly as requested
Option 1: Kickoff   Align goals, scope, and day priorities   Best first meeting for full-team context
Option 2: Design Review   Use Engineer 1 as the engineering representative   Keeps Engineer 2 free before engineering sync
Option 3: Engineering Sync   Follow design review so PM can carry decisions directly into engineering   Reduces rework risk
Option 4: Pricing Discussion   Put after lunch buffer for PM and Sales Lead   Short, focused decision slot
- The two engineers are treated as   Engineer 1   and   Engineer 2
- The design review uses   1 engineer  , assigned here to   Engineer 1   for continuity with the PM and design discussions
This leaves the afternoon from   13:45-17:30   open for focused work, follow-ups, or overflow.

rows: PM, Engineer 1, Engineer 2, Designer, Sales Lead
